title: Passing Objective 11 requires using DynamicISF for at least 28 days (suggestion: ignore #11 unless plugin is active)
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.2.0-dev-l**
**Flavor**: fullrelease

**Observation:**
Object 11 is shown as unfinished, can't complete/verify because not using (or planning to) DynamicISF

**Suggestion**:
Only enable/show object 11 when the DynamicISF plugin is activated as in ignore/hide when not using DynamicISF

comments.body:
You need only start it. And it's recommended to do it.
If more objectives come you'll need to have all previous finished
